defs.meaning: 保护器；保护者；保护装置；防御者

examples.en: I regarded him as my friend and protector.
examples.zh: 我视他为我的朋友和保护者。

examples.en: Many mothers see their son as a potential protector and provider.
examples.zh: 许多母亲将她们的儿子看作是潜在的保护人和赡养人。

examples.en: He was the only National League umpire to wear an outside chest protector.
examples.zh: 他是惟一穿着外层护胸的全国联盟裁判。

synonyms.meaning: [油气][安全]保护器；保护者；[电]保护装置；防御者
